payload.docs_match:
KILLER. Docs match the surface. se.guidance-phone-setup teaches pairing, WHEN A PUSH HAPPENS (your rule), and the brief store; se_wait's tool description says that waiting on an offer summons a paired phone. The verify step no longer tells you to wait for a buzz at a gate the agent self-blesses.

TWO AMENDMENTS, both from your rulings during this gate, both recorded rather than absorbed:

(1) THE CARD IS A DOORBELL, NOT A DOCUMENT. se-v2-design §11 rules it - 'ntfy carries the notification (click URL = page + #key)', explicitly NOT 'an editorially compressed brief'. I had built the card as the decision surface. The message is now ONE LINE and that line is the link; tapping the notification opens the page. With a page present the card carries NO action buttons at all, because a notification cannot show what is being blessed - offering to bless from it is the rubber-stamping this lane exists to prevent. The two direct actions survive only as the floor rung, for when no page could be published.

(2) THE PAGE IS THE DECISION SURFACE. §11 also rules 'the SAME rich handover HTML (v1-style drill-down, bless controls) on desk and phone', and §16 closed the blocker a month before I built it: CORS on the ntfy fetch VERIFIED PASS 2026-07-21, 'access-control-allow-origin: * on preflight, POST and subscribe - the phone bless path survives'. The hosted page now carries bless and dismiss and POSTs the answer itself. The answer topic and the offer hash ride INSIDE the ciphertext, so the host learns neither; the store token rides nowhere near the page, so it answers anonymously (R11).

AND THE CARD IS NOW ONE CARD, not two that look alike: engine/brief.ts briefHtml is the single renderer. projectState hands the board that exact markup as card_html, and the same string travels inside the phone page's ciphertext. The board adds its controls, the page adds its own. Two places to decide, one artifact - a duplicated decision card would have drifted, which is the duplication you have ruled against generally.
payload.packaged:
Versioned by the close: the tag iter/i8d-phone-brief is created BEFORE the merge, so the record stays reachable at the tag while trunk gets the live claims.

Trunk receives: engine/brief.ts (new - seal/unseal, the decision page with its own controls, the envelope, publish-and-confirm, the KV store), engine/phone.ts (rewritten - absolute URLs, one-line link card, X-Click, per-announce transport, announce recording, a transport that no longer swallows non-2xx), the park seam in engine/wait.ts, the wiring in engine/tools.ts, engine/project.ts serving the shared card, bin/se-board.ts with its announce timer removed and rendering the shared card, tests/i8d-brief.test.ts (23 checks), and the ledger updates.

32/32 green across the i8d, i8, board and worktree-board suites; typecheck clean. Machine-local config is excluded by design. Zero new runtime dependencies. Entry script: recorded skip with its reason.
payload.dependencies_ruled:
Zero runtime npm dependencies - node:crypto plus the platform's Web Crypto, and fetch. One new external service, Cloudflare Workers KV, opt-in per machine and NOT load-bearing: without it the card falls back to carrying the two direct actions.

kb stamped ABSENT on every grant. Nothing upstream patched or forked.

SIX TOOLING GAPS found while building this, all in RAID rather than absorbed silently, under the law you set today (se.law-workaround-then-record-the-gap): se_run bypasses the fence invisibly; se_file_patch has no batch mode; large files are unreadable through the lane; there is no lane for the machine-local config; an iteration cannot exercise its own build through the live surface; and the brief store's absence is silent.
payload.handover_accepted:
KILLER - yours.

WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE: one notification titled 'GATE i8d-phone-brief · gate_release' whose body is a single link and nothing else. Tap it. The page decrypts in your browser and shows THE SAME DECISION CARD the board shows - 'Gate: i8d-phone-brief' and the gate's full text - with 'bless as offered' and 'dismiss' fixed at the bottom of the screen. Tapping bless posts the answer itself and tells you it landed.

WHAT IT FIXES, each witnessed by you today: the action URLs that errored (both absolute now, built at send time); the encrypted hosted brief that §18 recorded as built but v2 never had; pushes fired by a timer that could not know my intent (now the run pushes exactly when it would otherwise wait for you); the card that was a wall of text instead of a link; and the controls that belonged in the page rather than the notification.

ALL THREE CHANNELS STILL WORK: console, board, phone - each records the same hash-bound grant with its own channel stamp.

WHAT I AM NOT CLAIMING: this card is sent by the new build invoked out-of-band, with the board stopped, because the live engine still runs trunk's code until this merges (se.raid-an-iteration-cannot-run-its-own-build). And the page is the DECISION CARD, not the whole board - no machine diagram, no log, no drill-down. You said 'at some point' for that; I am not pretending it is here.

If bless works from the page, the loop is proven by closing the thing that built it, and the grant records channel=phone, adjudicated_by=owner. If anything is still wrong, dismiss and tell me.
